PURPOSE.what_this_artifact_is: An adjudication plus a bounded future-execution grant. It answers three separable questions about the role uellix_auditor, derives the smallest privilege delta that makes the certified observation mechanically possible, proves BY MEASUREMENT which candidate privileges are not required, and defines the credential lifecycle, custody, delivery, rollback and poststate proof for the successor lane that will perform the provisioning.
PURPOSE.what_this_artifact_is_not: It is NOT a provisioning. No hosted PostgreSQL socket was opened, no SQL was issued against any hosted target, no credential was created, rotated, read, printed or requested, no GRANT or REVOKE was executed anywhere, no Supabase or Vercel configuration was mutated, and no repository surface outside the two documents of this write set was touched. PROBLEM_STATEMENT.statement: A certified read-only observation exists and cannot run. Two independent facts block it: no credential reaches the executor, and no package in this repository grants the authorized role the one schema privilege the observation's first probe requires. Neither fact is repairable from inside the observation authority, which withholds every mutation from itself absolutely and regardless of outcome. The question this artifact answers is what the SMALLEST capability is that can legitimately perform that observation, and how to prove it is no more powerful than necessary.
PROBLEM_STATEMENT.why_the_objective_is_not_making_PRECHECK: The convenient repair is to connect as uellix_app, which db/prepared/stella_0014_operation_tickets.sql:220 grants USAGE ON SCHEMA uellix_stella_ops and which would therefore almost certainly resolve both literals on the first attempt. The D-1 authority forbids it in terms and forbids it PRECISELY BECAUSE IT WOULD WORK. This artifact inherits that reasoning without softening it: an audit measurement taken with a runtime credential is the most-privileged-reading-wins failure the capability split was built to end, and db/safety/resolve-capability-database-url.ts says so in its own header.
PROBLEM_STATEMENT.the_asymmetry_that_makes_this_hard: Every privilege that would make the observation succeed also makes the credential more valuable to an attacker, and the role in question ALREADY holds SELECT on roughly forty tables of customer data. The minimum is therefore not the smallest set that works, but the smallest DELTA on top of a prior state this artifact does not control and must not silently ratify.

rows.disproof: The authorized surface reads exactly two columns of one infrastructure table. The parent's EXPLICITLY_UNAUTHORIZED_READS enumerates the refusals, including a count of zero.

rows.privilege: CREATE on schema uellix_stella_ops, uellix_bootstrap, public or any schema
rows.disproof: The observation creates nothing. stella_hosted_0001:302 and stella_0001:200 already REVOKE CREATE ON SCHEMA public from this role, so granting CREATE anywhere would reverse an existing governed decision.
E-11 shows TEMP is already PUBLIC-derived and present; E-10 shows CREATE TEMP TABLE is blocked by the read-only transaction regardless. Nothing needs it and nothing can use it.
rows.disposition: NOT GRANTED. Its pre-existing PUBLIC-derived presence is recorded in PUBLIC_PRIVILEGE_CONTRACT rather than removed.

rows.privilege: Any INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, REFERENCES, TRIGGER or MAINTAIN, anywhere
rows.disproof: The observation is read-only by construction, and stella_0021:459-466 and :567-571 already refuse to build on a database where this role holds any of them.

rows.privilege: Any DDL capability or object ownership
rows.disproof: stella_0021:474 aborts if uellix_auditor owns any relation in the contract set.
E-8. A membership WITH SET TRUE defeats NOINHERIT entirely, and E-10 shows it defeats the read-only transaction as a confidentiality boundary too. No membership is needed for any authorized read.
rows.disposition: PROHIBITED ABSOLUTELY. Grounds mutants M7, M8, M13.

rows.disproof: No authorized statement requires any of them, and stella_hosted_0000 section 5 already fails its own verification if any of the five managed roles holds one.
rows.disposition: PROHIBITED ABSOLUTELY. Grounds mutants M9, M10.

DANGEROUS_WIDENING_REGISTER.question_answered: J — which privileges would constitute dangerous widening?
DANGEROUS_WIDENING_REGISTER.rule: Ordered by how plausible the mistake is, not by how bad it sounds. The first three are the ones a competent, well-intentioned executor might actually do.

rows.widening: GRANT EXECUTE on complete_operation_ticket, on the reasoning that the probe names a function so the role must be allowed to use it.
rows.why_it_is_dangerous: It converts a role that can only ASK WHETHER A VERB EXISTS into a role that can UTTER IT. complete_operation_ticket is the closing verb of the governed ticket protocol; a leaked auditor credential holding EXECUTE on it could close tickets. E-2 proves the grant buys nothing.
rows.plausibility: HIGH. It is the intuitive reading of a function-shaped probe.

rows.widening: GRANT ALL or GRANT CREATE on uellix_stella_ops while granting USAGE, because ALL is one word shorter than USAGE.
rows.why_it_is_dangerous: CREATE on the schema lets the role define objects inside the governed ticket schema, which is a structural capability on a surface whose whole design is that only capability roles reach it.

rows.widening: GRANT membership in uellix_app or uellix_migrator so the auditor inherits what it needs.
rows.why_it_is_dangerous: E-8 and E-10 measured that a membership WITH SET TRUE is reachable by SET ROLE even under NOINHERIT and even inside a read-only transaction. Membership in uellix_migrator additionally reaches uellix_owner by SET, per the membership stella_hosted_0000 creates, so this single grant would put schema ownership within two statements of an audit credential.
rows.plausibility: MEDIUM. Grounds mutants M7 and M13.

rows.widening: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA, or a broad pg_catalog grant, to make the preflight more informative.
rows.why_it_is_dangerous: It is a customer-data or catalog-enumeration widening bought for a diagnostic convenience E-4 proves is unnecessary.
rows.plausibility: MEDIUM. Grounds mutants M6 and M30.

rows.widening: Leaving or setting BYPASSRLS, SUPERUSER, CREATEROLE, CREATEDB or REPLICATION.
rows.why_it_is_dangerous: BYPASSRLS in particular would silently convert the auditor's existing forty-table SELECT from a tenant-scoped read into a whole-database read, with no statement changing anywhere.
rows.plausibility: LOW as a deliberate act, NON-TRIVIAL as an inherited prestate nobody checked. Grounds mutants M9 and M10, and it is why the poststate asserts all five as booleans rather than assuming the package's self-verification ran.

rows.widening: Raising the role's statement_timeout or idle_in_transaction_session_timeout to let a probe finish.
rows.why_it_is_dangerous: The 60s bounds at stella_g2_roles:184-185 and stella_0005b:127-128 are a containment on how long a read-only audit session can hold resources. The authorized surface is eight trivial reads; a timeout that is too short is a signal, not an obstacle.
rows.plausibility: LOW, and recorded because it is the kind of change that looks like tuning.

GRANT_DELIVERY_CHANNEL_ADJUDICATION.question: If REQ-2 is needed, HOW may it be delivered?
GRANT_DELIVERY_CHANNEL_ADJUDICATION.verdict: AS A GOVERNED db/prepared/** PACKAGE, AND NOT AS AN AD-HOC STATEMENT.
GRANT_DELIVERY_CHANNEL_ADJUDICATION.reasoning: Every hosted GRANT in this repository's history travels through a prepared package with preconditions, self-verification and a pinned manifest entry. The parent itself, listing what is not authorized in response to the capability stop, names authoring a package that would grant it as the mechanism, and declines it only because it is outside THAT lane's write set. RULE_NO_GATE_WEAKENING forbids reaching for a thinner channel because the thicker one is inconvenient.
GRANT_DELIVERY_CHANNEL_ADJUDICATION.the_consequence_stated_plainly: db/prepared/** is a PROTECTED SURFACE under scripts/ods-scope.ts DEFAULT_PROTECTED_PATTERNS. Authoring that package therefore requires a PROTECTED-SURFACE ALLOCATION that does not exist at AS_OF_TREE. That allocation is a GATE, and it is named in NEXT_GATE rather than assumed away.
GRANT_DELIVERY_CHANNEL_ADJUDICATION.what_this_artifact_does_NOT_do: It does not author the package, does not name its number, does not reserve a lineage position, does not invent an ODS or W2 identifier, and does not assert that the allocation will be granted. Section 23 of the lane mandate forbids the write and the parent's NEW_ODS_REQUIRED.explicit_non_allocation forbids the invention.
GRANT_DELIVERY_CHANNEL_ADJUDICATION.the_ordering_this_forces_and_why_it_is_c: REQ-1 must precede REQ-2, because whether REQ-2 is needed at all is a MEASUREMENT that requires an authenticated session. A sequence that provisioned the grant first would be granting on repository intent rather than on hosted prestate, which is mutant M23 and mutant M24 at once.
GRANT_DELIVERY_CHANNEL_ADJUDICATION.a_narrower_alternative_is_recorded_and_n: A single ad-hoc GRANT statement executed under an execution authority, with prestate and rollback, would be materially smaller than a package and would avoid the protected-surface gate entirely. It is NOT chosen, because choosing it would set the precedent that a hosted GRANT may bypass the prepared-package channel whenever a lane finds the channel slow, and that precedent is worth more to a future mistake than this grant is worth to this lane. Recorded as OD-5 so the owner may overrule this artifact deliberately rather than a successor doing it quietly.

EFFECTIVE_PRIVILEGE_CONTRACT.question_answered: P — what privileges may arrive INDIRECTLY, and how is EFFECTIVE privilege distinguished from granted privilege?
EFFECTIVE_PRIVILEGE_CONTRACT.rule: The question is never whether a GRANT statement exists. It is what the role CAN DO. Five indirect channels are enumerated, each with the probe that answers it and the measurement that shows why the probe is needed.

channels.repository_state: CONNECT and TEMP are PUBLIC-derived and present on a stock engine (E-5, E-11). No package in this repository grants CONNECT to any uellix role, and none revokes it from PUBLIC. stella_0001:200 DOES revoke CREATE ON SCHEMA public from PUBLIC.
channels.probe: has_database_privilege('uellix_auditor', current_database(), 'CONNECT') and the same for 'TEMP'; plus the same two for the pseudo-role public.
channels.why_it_matters: E-5 measured that revoking CONNECT from PUBLIC breaks this capability at AUTHENTICATION time with a message that looks nothing like a privilege problem. A future hardening could therefore break D1-8 in a way whose symptom points at the credential.

channels.repository_state: ZERO. Measured: git grep for both membership forms over db/ returns no hit, and MANAGED_ROLE_MEMBERSHIPS enumerates two memberships not involving the auditor.
channels.probe: SELECT over pg_auth_members joined to pg_roles in BOTH directions, projecting inherit_option, set_option and admin_option, plus the grantor.
channels.why_it_matters: E-8. A membership WITH SET TRUE defeats NOINHERIT completely.

channels.probe: pg_has_role('uellix_auditor', <role>, 'MEMBER') and 'USAGE' and 'SET', evaluated against uellix_owner, uellix_migrator, uellix_app, uellix_writer, postgres, supabase_admin, service_role, authenticator, and every uellix_cap_* role present.
channels.why_it_matters: pg_has_role answers CAN THIS ROLE REACH THAT ONE BY ANY PATH, which is the direction that matters. stella_hosted_0000 section 5(2) uses exactly this construction for the runtime, with its own words: not is there a grant but can this role reach that one, by any path. The poststate borrows the construction rather than inventing one.

channels.repository_state: PRESENT AND MATERIAL. ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE uellix_owner IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES and ON SEQUENCES TO uellix_auditor, at stella_g2_schema:11776 and :11740 and again at stella_0005_runtime_cutover:398 and :404.
channels.probe: SELECT over pg_default_acl filtered on the auditor as grantee.
channels.why_it_matters: It is the one channel that grants privilege on objects THAT DO NOT YET EXIST. Any table uellix_owner creates in public becomes auditor-readable automatically, with no GRANT statement written anywhere and nothing for a grep to find. It is scoped to schema public and FOR ROLE uellix_owner, so it does NOT reach uellix_stella_ops and does NOT supply REQ-2 — a point worth stating because a reader who found it might reasonably think it did.

channels.channel: DATABASE-LEVEL and SCHEMA-LEVEL privileges held without an object grant
channels.repository_state: USAGE on public and on uellix_bootstrap granted; CREATE on public explicitly revoked.
channels.probe: has_schema_privilege for USAGE and CREATE over public, uellix_bootstrap, uellix_stella_ops, uellix_grounding, uellix_stella, auth and storage.
channels.why_it_matters: A schema the auditor can reach but that nobody inventoried is the shape of an undetected widening. The probe is written over a NAMED LIST rather than over all schemas, because enumerating every schema is itself a catalog read the parent's EXPLICITLY_UNAUTHORIZED_READS refuses for the observation lane; the provisioning lane's list is bounded to the schemas this repository actually creates.

PRE_EXISTING_SURFACE_INVENTORY.rule: Recorded so the certifier can see exactly what this act does NOT touch, and so that nobody later reads the minimum delta as a description of the role.
PRE_EXISTING_SURFACE_INVENTORY.inventory: Roughly forty tables of public SELECT from the baseline, plus evidence_document_versions, evidence_chunks, stella_interactions and conditionally stella_suggestion_decisions; EXECUTE on three public RLS helpers via stella_hosted_0006:469 and the baseline's GRANT ALL ON FUNCTION at stella_g2_schema:10548/:10559/:10570; EXECUTE on uellix_bootstrap.hosted_capability_report() via stella_hosted_0001:619; USAGE on public and uellix_bootstrap; SELECT default privileges for future uellix_owner tables and sequences in public.
PRE_EXISTING_SURFACE_INVENTORY.classification: EXCESS RELATIVE TO D-1, PRE-EXISTING, AND GOVERNED BY OTHER AUTHORITIES.
PRE_EXISTING_SURFACE_INVENTORY.disposition: NOT REMOVED, NOT WIDENED, AND ASSERTED UNCHANGED BY THE POSTSTATE. Removing any of it would break the contracts of stella_hosted_0006, stella_hosted_0007 and stella_0021, and is outside this artifact's scope in both directions.
PRE_EXISTING_SURFACE_INVENTORY.the_honest_consequence_stated: uellix_auditor is a BROAD READ-ONLY AUDITOR, not a narrow catalog observer. The D-1 observation uses a vanishingly small fraction of what the role can read. This is a true and uncomfortable fact about the capability, it is the reason SSL-06 is adjudicated as ENGAGED below, and stating it is not a criticism of the packages that built the role for a different purpose.
PRE_EXISTING_SURFACE_INVENTORY.a_narrower_capability_is_recorded_as_a_p: A dedicated least-privilege catalog-observer role would be materially smaller than uellix_auditor for this purpose. It is NOT proposed, because the D-1 observation authority names uellix_auditor as its AUTHORIZED_DATABASE_ROLE as a frozen constant and db/safety/database-role.ts pins it as a compile-time constant; proposing a different role would be this artifact overriding a certified parent on a point the parent decided. Recorded as OD-4 so the owner can raise it as a successor question.

ROLE_ATTRIBUTE_CONTRACT.question_answered: The role-attribute half of the prompt's privilege-minimization requirement.

rolinherit.verdict: NOT PINNED BY THIS ARTIFACT, AND THE REASON IS A MEASURED LINEAGE DIVERGENCE PLUS A MEASURED IRRELEVANCE.
rolinherit.the_divergence_measured: The HOSTED lineage creates uellix_auditor WITH INHERIT — stella_hosted_0000:175 and :178, derived from db/hosted/managed-role-identities.ts and pinned by that module's sha256. The BASELINE and the two non-hosted lineages create it NOINHERIT — stella_g2_roles:88, stella_0001:83, stella_local_0000:276. Worse than a stylistic split: db/prepared/stella_0004_role_separation.sql:955-957 lists rolinherit among the FORBIDDEN attributes for all five uellix roles and RAISES AN EXCEPTION if any of them carries it. So a package in this repository treats as a hard failure the exact attribute the hosted identity package deliberately sets.
rolinherit.is_this_a_conflict_that_requires_a_STOP: NO, AND THE REASONING IS STATED SO A CERTIFIER CAN REJECT IT. stella_0004 governs the self-hosted role-separation lineage; stella_hosted_0000 governs the managed-Supabase lineage and is the byte-pinned source of truth for it. They are two lineages with two contracts, not one contract contradicting itself, and CLAUDE.md's fail-closed rule bites on a conflict between authorities that both govern the same surface. They do not.
rolinherit.why_it_is_MATERIALLY_IRRELEVANT_here: E-8 measured that INHERIT versus NOINHERIT decides only whether privileges flow IMPLICITLY from a membership. With ZERO memberships, INHERIT confers exactly nothing. The repository grants the auditor zero memberships, so the attribute is INERT on repository evidence.
rolinherit.why_it_is_therefore_NOT_pinned: Pinning NOINHERIT would put this artifact in direct contradiction with a sha256-pinned hosted package, and would demand a hosted ALTER ROLE whose only effect on a zero-membership role is to change a catalog column. Pinning INHERIT would contradict stella_0004. This artifact pins NEITHER and pins the thing that actually controls the risk instead: ZERO MEMBERSHIPS, in ROLE_MEMBERSHIP_CONTRACT.
rolinherit.the_latent_risk_recorded_rather_than_rep: If any future act grants uellix_auditor a membership on the HOSTED target, INHERIT makes that membership's privileges effective SILENTLY, with no SET ROLE and no statement in any session. The membership assertion is what catches it, which is why that assertion is phrased over pg_auth_members and pg_has_role rather than over the attribute. Flagged as OF-5.

rolconnlimit.verdict: NOT REQUIRED, NOT PINNED, OBSERVED ONLY.
rolconnlimit.reasoning: No package sets it. A connection limit is a resource control, and constraining an audit role to a small number of concurrent sessions is defensible operational hygiene that no authority has decided. Recorded as an observation field so a poststate that finds a surprising value reports it. Proposing a value would be this artifact inventing policy.

rolvaliduntil.engineering_recommendation: Set it. A VALID UNTIL on the auditor credential converts credential removal from an act someone must remember into a property of the credential. Its cost is that an expired credential presents as an authentication failure, which E-9 measured is indistinguishable from a wrong password — so an expiry that nobody records is a future diagnosis nobody can make.
rolvaliduntil.binding_condition_if_the_owner_sets_it: The exact timestamp is recorded in the capability evidence artifact, in UTC, as a NON-SECRET field. An expiry whose value is unknown to the next lane is worse than no expiry, because it turns a scheduled event into an unexplained outage.
rolvaliduntil.why_this_artifact_does_not_decide_it: It is a tradeoff between credential exposure window and operational availability of a release-gate observation, and the owner holds both sides.

session_defaults.required_present: default_transaction_read_only = on, set by stella_g2_roles:182 and stella_0001:84 and stella_local_0000:277.
session_defaults.observed_not_pinned: search_path = public, statement_timeout = 60s, idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = 60s, from stella_g2_roles:183-185 and stella_0005b:126-128.
session_defaults.explicit_warning_carried_from_code: db/safety/database-target.ts records that a connection option can override the read-only session default. The default is therefore a SETTING and not a CONTROL, which is exactly why READ_ONLY_PROOF does not rest on it.

ROLE_ATTRIBUTE_CONTRACT.poststate_assertion_form: All six required attributes are read as BOOLEANS from pg_catalog.pg_roles in ONE statement and asserted individually. Reading them is not enough: an assertion that merely SELECTs the row and prints it is mutant M22's shape, where the evidence exists and nothing checks it.

ROLE_MEMBERSHIP_CONTRACT.question_answered: O — does uellix_auditor need membership in another role?
ROLE_MEMBERSHIP_CONTRACT.verdict: NO. NOT ONE, IN EITHER DIRECTION.
ROLE_MEMBERSHIP_CONTRACT.required_end_state: uellix_auditor is a member of NOTHING, and NOTHING is a member of uellix_auditor.
ROLE_MEMBERSHIP_CONTRACT.repository_evidence: ZERO memberships. Measured by git grep for GRANT <role> TO uellix_auditor and GRANT uellix_auditor TO <role> across db/ at AS_OF_TREE, both returning no hit, and corroborated by db/hosted/managed-role-identities.ts MANAGED_ROLE_MEMBERSHIPS, which enumerates exactly two and names neither side as the auditor.
ROLE_MEMBERSHIP_CONTRACT.why_this_is_the_LOAD_BEARING_control_and: E-8, measured: a NOINHERIT role holding membership WITH INHERIT FALSE, SET TRUE could not read the privileged role's table, then executed SET ROLE, read it, and reset. E-10, measured: the same SET ROLE succeeds INSIDE BEGIN READ ONLY. So neither the attribute nor the transaction closes the path. The only thing that closes it is the membership not existing.
ROLE_MEMBERSHIP_CONTRACT.the_specific_escalation_this_forbids: Membership in uellix_migrator would be the worst single grant available, because stella_hosted_0000 section 4 grants uellix_migrator membership in uellix_owner WITH SET TRUE. An auditor that could SET ROLE to the migrator could SET ROLE again to the owner, and the owner owns the schema. Two statements from an audit credential to object ownership.
poststate_assertion_form: A COUNT over pg_auth_members in BOTH directions for uellix_auditor must be ZERO, with inherit_option, set_option, admin_option and grantor projected for any row found so that a non-zero result is actionable rather than merely red.

pg_has_role('uellix_auditor', <role>, 'MEMBER') must be FALSE for uellix_owner, uellix_migrator, uellix_app, uellix_writer, postgres, supabase_admin, service_role and authenticator. Asserted with pg_has_role and NOT only with a pg_auth_members count, because the count answers is there an edge and pg_has_role answers can it reach, and a transitive path is exactly what a direct-edge count misses.
ROLE_MEMBERSHIP_CONTRACT.authorized_repair_if_a_membership_is_fou: NONE IS PRE-AUTHORIZED. A membership found hosted that no package explains is a finding about the hosted target that this artifact did not create and must not silently correct. The successor STOPS with STOP_UNEXPLAINED_ROLE_MEMBERSHIP, records the exact edge with its options and grantor, and the question goes to whoever governs the identity chain. Revoking it would destroy the evidence of how it got there.

OBJECT_OWNERSHIP_CONTRACT.question_answered: The ownership half of the privilege-minimization requirement.
OBJECT_OWNERSHIP_CONTRACT.required_end_state: uellix_auditor owns NOTHING: no database, no schema, no relation of any kind, no function, no type, no sequence.
OBJECT_OWNERSHIP_CONTRACT.why_ownership_is_worse_than_a_grant: An owner's privileges are not in any ACL. They are implied, they cannot be revoked without changing the owner, and an owner can GRANT to others. A role that owns an object is therefore permanently outside any inventory written over grants, which is exactly the inventory this artifact builds.
OBJECT_OWNERSHIP_CONTRACT.repository_evidence: No package makes uellix_auditor the owner of anything. Corroborated from the other side by db/prepared/stella_0021_current_schema_runtime_acl_contract.sql:474, which ABORTS if a relation in its contract set is owned by uellix_writer, uellix_auditor or uellix_app. The repository already refuses to build on a database where this is false.
OBJECT_OWNERSHIP_CONTRACT.poststate_assertion_form: A COUNT over pg_class WHERE relowner = 'uellix_auditor'::regrole must be ZERO; the same over pg_namespace.nspowner, pg_proc.proowner and pg_type.typowner; and pg_database.datdba for the current database must not be the auditor. Asserted as four separate zeros rather than one union, so a failure names WHICH kind of object.
OBJECT_OWNERSHIP_CONTRACT.authorized_repair_if_ownership_is_found: NONE. Reassigning ownership is a structural act on a governed surface. STOP_UNEXPECTED_AUDITOR_OWNERSHIP.

PUBLIC_PRIVILEGE_CONTRACT.question_answered: The PUBLIC half of P, and mutant M12.
PUBLIC_PRIVILEGE_CONTRACT.rule: PUBLIC-derived privileges are EFFECTIVE privileges. They appear in no GRANT statement naming the role, so an inventory built by grepping for the role name misses them entirely. Two of them are load-bearing here.

PP_1_CONNECT.state: PRESENT VIA PUBLIC, NOT GRANTED. Measured E-5 on a stock engine; git grep for CONNECT ON DATABASE over db/ and scripts/ returns ZERO hits.
PP_1_CONNECT.load_bearing: TOTALLY. E-5 measured that revoking it from PUBLIC blocks the connection outright with FATAL permission denied for database.
PP_1_CONNECT.disposition: ASSERTED PRESENT BY THE POSTSTATE. NOT GRANTED BY THIS ACT.
PP_1_CONNECT.if_the_poststate_finds_it_ABSENT: STOP_CONNECT_PRIVILEGE_ABSENT, and it is a FINDING about a hardening this repository does not record, not a licence to GRANT CONNECT. Granting it would reverse a decision somebody made deliberately and did not write down here.

PP_2_TEMP.state: PRESENT VIA PUBLIC, NOT GRANTED. Measured E-11.
PP_2_TEMP.load_bearing: NOT AT ALL. Nothing in the authorized surface creates a temporary object, and E-10 measured that CREATE TEMP TABLE fails inside the read-only transaction anyway.
PP_2_TEMP.disposition: OBSERVED AND RECORDED, NEITHER GRANTED NOR REVOKED. Revoking TEMP from PUBLIC would be a database-wide change affecting every role, made by a capability lane, to close a path the read-only transaction already closes. That is out of all proportion.

PP_3_EXECUTE_on_functions.state: PostgreSQL grants EXECUTE to PUBLIC by default on every newly created function. This repository fights that default explicitly: stella_hosted_0001:612 revokes ALL on hosted_capability_report from PUBLIC, anon, authenticated and service_role; the baseline revokes ALL from PUBLIC on the RLS helpers and the net.* functions; db/migrations/0033 revokes EXECUTE on ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA public from PUBLIC, anon and authenticated.
PP_3_EXECUTE_on_functions.relevance_here: It is why E-2 had to REVOKE EXECUTE FROM PUBLIC before it could measure resolution-without-EXECUTE at all. A measurement that had skipped the revoke would have had EXECUTE present by default and would have proved nothing.
PP_3_EXECUTE_on_functions.disposition: OBSERVED. This act creates no function and therefore creates no new PUBLIC EXECUTE.

PUBLIC_PRIVILEGE_CONTRACT.poststate_assertion_form: has_database_privilege('public', current_database(), 'CONNECT') and the same for 'TEMP', recorded as booleans alongside the role's own. Recording BOTH the role's and PUBLIC's is the point: if the role's CONNECT is true and PUBLIC's is also true, the role holds it VIA PUBLIC and holds nothing of its own, and that distinction is invisible if only the role is probed.
PUBLIC_PRIVILEGE_CONTRACT.why_a_lane_would_get_this_wrong: Because has_database_privilege('uellix_auditor', ..., 'CONNECT') returns TRUE in both worlds. The probe that looks like it answers the question does not answer it.

USAGE_IS_NOT_EXECUTE.question_answered: L, and prompt section 10, which requires the distinction to be adjudicated explicitly rather than assumed.

the_two_things.USAGE ON SCHEMA uellix_stella_ops: The right to RESOLVE NAMES inside the schema. It confers no SELECT on any relation, no EXECUTE on any routine, and no row.
the_two_things.EXECUTE ON FUNCTION uellix_stella_ops.co: The right to CALL the function.

USAGE_IS_NOT_EXECUTE.what_the_D_1_probe_actually_does: It evaluates pg_catalog.to_regprocedure over a fixed literal. The parent's own words: the observation asks whether a verb exists; it never utters the verb. to_regprocedure returns an OID-typed value and does not invoke what it names.
USAGE_IS_NOT_EXECUTE.MEASURED_ANSWER: EXECUTE IS NOT REQUIRED. E-2: with has_function_privilege false for the probing role after REVOKE ALL ... FROM PUBLIC, to_regprocedure resolved the seven-argument literal to a non-NULL regprocedure echoing back byte-identical to the canonical literal, resolved the nine-argument literal to NULL, and an actual call in the same session failed with permission denied for function.
USAGE_IS_NOT_EXECUTE.RULING: GRANTING EXECUTE ON complete_operation_ticket AT EITHER ARITY, TO uellix_auditor, IS PROHIBITED ABSOLUTELY BY THIS ARTIFACT. It is unnecessary, it is disproven rather than merely unjustified, and its absence is an ACTIVE SAFETY PROPERTY rather than a neutral omission.
USAGE_IS_NOT_EXECUTE.the_safety_property_stated_positively: Without EXECUTE, the role is STRUCTURALLY INCAPABLE of closing an operation ticket. The parent's procedural rule that the probe must never be followed by a call is therefore enforced at the GRANT LAYER, where it holds even against a lane that ignored the procedure, and not only in prose.
USAGE_IS_NOT_EXECUTE.what_would_change_this_ruling: A measurement showing that to_regprocedure consults the function ACL on some engine. E-2 disproves it on PostgreSQL 17.10; PHASE_P3 re-observes on the hosted engine; and if the hosted observation ever contradicted E-2, that is a STOP and a finding, not a licence to grant EXECUTE.

SECRET_GENERATION_CONTRACT.question_answered: R — how is the auditor credential generated? And the create-versus-rotate-versus-reuse question of prompt section 13.

CREATE_ROTATE_OR_REUSE.verdict: ROTATE. The successor MINTS A NEW SECRET and sets it, rather than attempting to discover or recover an existing one.
reasoning: E-9 measured that a client CANNOT determine whether a credential already exists: no-credential and wrong-credential produce the identical FATAL message. A recovery strategy therefore begins with a question the executor cannot answer.

A password hash in pg_authid is not reversible, so there is nothing to recover even with superuser access. The only recoverable form would be a stored plaintext, and if one exists somewhere unrecorded, that is itself the SSL-06 finding rather than a resource.

Rotation is IDEMPOTENT over the unknown. It produces the same known end state whether the prior state was no credential, a forgotten credential or a credential held by someone unrecorded, and it is the ONLY act with that property here.
Rotation REVOKES any unrecorded prior holder as a side effect, which is the correct default for a credential whose custody is unknown.
CREATE_ROTATE_OR_REUSE.the_cost_stated_honestly: If an unrecorded consumer currently authenticates as uellix_auditor against staging, rotation BREAKS IT, immediately and without warning. HOSTED_STATE_UNKNOWN HU-4 means this artifact cannot rule that out. The breakage is bounded to staging, the role is read-only by grant, and the owner is asked to accept it explicitly as OD-2 rather than discovering it.

generation_requirements.entropy: At least 32 bytes from a cryptographically secure random source.
generation_requirements.encoding: base64url, so the value survives placement in a URL userinfo field without percent-encoding.
generation_requirements.precedent_for_both: scripts/rotate-local-role-credentials.ts generatePassword, whose own comment states the reasoning: a password that needs escaping is a password that gets escaped wrong somewhere down the line.
generation_requirements.generated_where: In the operator's own secure environment or by the management plane itself. NOT by a repository script, because no repository script can reach a hosted target and none may be made to.

SSL_06_ADJUDICATION.the_question: SSL-06 states that no PRIVILEGED credential may be held without an inventory recording who and what holds it. Is the auditor credential privileged?
SSL_06_ADJUDICATION.the_parent_position: FIBDB053_D1_OLD_DB_OBSERVATION_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json READ_ONLY_CAPABILITY_CONTRACT.ssl_06_tripwire states that uellix_auditor is least-privileged by design, so SSL-06 is not engaged by THAT grant, and that SSL-06 IS engaged if the lane finds itself holding an OPERATOR credential.
SSL_06_ADJUDICATION.THIS_ARTIFACT_VERDICT: SSL-06 IS ENGAGED BY THE ACT OF PROVISIONING THE CREDENTIAL, ON CONFIDENTIALITY GROUNDS.
SSL_06_ADJUDICATION.reasoning: Least-privileged in this programme has consistently meant holding no WRITE power, and on that axis the parent is right and nothing here disturbs it. SSL-06 is a CUSTODY rule, and custody risk is measured by what a leaked credential DISCLOSES as well as by what it can change. Measured in MRS_5: uellix_auditor holds SELECT on roughly forty tables including public.users, public.organizations, public.organization_members, public.audit_logs, public.evidence_items and public.stella_interactions. A leaked auditor credential is a full staging data-confidentiality breach with no write anywhere. A rule that only engaged on write power would leave that uninventoried.
SSL_06_ADJUDICATION.IS_THIS_A_CONTRADICTION_OF_A_CERTIFIED_P: NO, AND THE DISTINCTION IS EXACT. The parent's clause is scoped to THE GRANT IT MAKES — an observation permission that creates, mints and touches no credential, and whose lane never holds one. This artifact governs a DIFFERENT ACT that the parent explicitly declined to govern: its SECRET_CUSTODY_CONTRACT.provisioning states in terms that the artifact does not name, choose, create, rotate or compare an approved secure source. The custody question arises in THIS artifact's domain, not in the parent's, and the parent is not edited, amended or reinterpreted.
SSL_06_ADJUDICATION.CONSEQUENT_BINDING_REQUIREMENT: Before the credential is minted, an INVENTORY ENTRY must exist recording WHO and WHAT holds it. NAMES AND ROLES ONLY, never the value, per SSL-08. The entry records: the capability name, the role, the target project ref, the human custodian, every process or environment that will hold it, the mint date, the expiry if OD-3 sets one, and the planned removal date. Where that inventory LIVES is OD-2, because no inventory surface exists at AS_OF_TREE and inventing one is an owner's choice, not a lane's.
SSL_06_ADJUDICATION.flagged: OF-6, so an independent certifier can reject this reading and restore the parent's.

WINDOWS_USER_LEVEL_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE_.question: Is setx or a user-scope environment variable acceptable under current repository security policy?
WINDOWS_USER_LEVEL_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE_.verdict: NOT AUTHORIZED AS A DEFAULT, AND NOT PROHIBITED OUTRIGHT. IT IS AN OWNER DECISION — OD-2 — AND THE SPECIFIC RISKS ARE NAMED SO THE OWNER DECIDES ON FACTS.
what_it_satisfies: It is outside the repository working tree, so it cannot be committed and cannot affect ods:scope or the untracked arm.
It does not appear in the process table of the consuming command.
It is not pasted into chat.
It reaches the process as an environment variable, which is exactly the shape the resolver requires.
what_it_does_NOT_satisfy: PERSISTENCE. A user-scope variable set with setx survives every reboot until deliberately removed, so a mechanism chosen for a temporary need creates a permanent exposure by default. That is mutant M26 in its most ordinary form: the removal is a step someone has to remember.

SCOPE. It is readable by EVERY process that user runs, not only the intended one. On a developer workstation that includes editors, extensions, package postinstall scripts and any tooling with telemetry.
REGISTRY PERSISTENCE. It is stored in the user registry hive and is captured by ordinary profile backups and by some endpoint-management tooling, in plaintext.

SHELL HISTORY. The COMMAND THAT SETS IT carries the value as an argument, so the delivery act reintroduces exactly the command-line disclosure the mechanism was chosen to avoid. This is the decisive objection: the variable may be safe once set, and setting it is not.

CONDITIONS_UNDER_WHICH_IT_BECOMES_ACCEPT.rule: If and only if the owner selects it as OD-2, ALL of the following bind, and a mechanism that cannot satisfy every one of them is not used.
conditions: PROCESS-SCOPED, NOT USER-SCOPED. The variable is set in the environment of the single command that consumes it and does not persist to a new shell.
NOT SET BY A COMMAND THAT CARRIES THE VALUE AS AN ARGUMENT. It is read from the secret store into the process environment, never typed or pasted into a command line.
SHELL HISTORY IS DISABLED FOR THE SESSION, or the session is a fresh non-persisting one.
REMOVED IMMEDIATELY after the consuming process exits, on BOTH the success and the failure path.
POSITIVE ABSENCE VERIFICATION after removal, recorded in the evidence artifact as a boolean. Absence is asserted from a check, never from the fact that a removal command was issued.

WINDOWS_USER_LEVEL_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE_.ENGINEERING_RECOMMENDATION: A dedicated secret manager or OS credential vault, read into the process environment at invocation, is preferable on every axis above and removes the removal step entirely by never persisting the value outside the vault. It is NOT mandated, because no such mechanism is established in this repository at AS_OF_TREE and mandating an absent tool would produce an authority nobody can satisfy.
WINDOWS_USER_LEVEL_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE_.why_this_artifact_refuses_to_simply_deci: The lane mandate is explicit that a Windows environment variable must not be mandated merely because it is convenient, and that a delivery path which is convenient but not demonstrably compliant must not be authorized. Neither candidate is demonstrably compliant at AS_OF_TREE: one has named defects, the other does not exist here yet. Choosing between an accepted risk and a new tool is an owner's call.

REMOVAL_AFTER_USE.question_answered: W — when and how is the temporary execution exposure removed?
REMOVAL_AFTER_USE.when: IMMEDIATELY after the consuming process exits — after PRECHECK-R2 and again after the FINAL WITNESS — on the success path and the failure path alike.
REMOVAL_AFTER_USE.how: Per the mechanism OD-2 selects, followed in every case by POSITIVE ABSENCE VERIFICATION recorded as a boolean in the capability evidence artifact.
REMOVAL_AFTER_USE.the_rule_that_makes_it_hold: The removal is a STEP OF THE PROCEDURE, not a courtesy at the end of it. A sequence that ends at a green observation and leaves the credential in place has completed the observation and failed the capability contract, and the evidence artifact records the removal verification as a FIELD so its absence is a hole rather than a silence.

SECRET_ROTATION_CONTRACT.question_answered: X — how is credential rotation handled?
SECRET_ROTATION_CONTRACT.rotation_is_the_provisioning_act: Per SECRET_GENERATION_CONTRACT, the initial provisioning IS a rotation. There is no separate first-mint path, which removes the branch where a lane has to decide whether it is creating or replacing.

MANDATORY_ROTATION_AFTER_FINAL_WITNESS.verdict: OWNER DECISION — OD-1, of which this is the second half.
MANDATORY_ROTATION_AFTER_FINAL_WITNESS.engineering_recommendation: MANDATORY. The credential's only governed purpose ends when the FINAL WITNESS is recorded. A credential that outlives its purpose has an exposure window bounded by nothing.
MANDATORY_ROTATION_AFTER_FINAL_WITNESS.the_argument_against_it_stated_fairly: If the auditor capability is genuinely standing, as db/safety/resolve-capability-database-url.ts describes it, then rotating after every use makes every future audit begin with an owner act and a human confirmation, which in practice means audits happen less often. A control that reduces auditing is not obviously a security win.

SECRET_ROTATION_CONTRACT.rotation_mechanics: Identical to the initial mint: same entropy, same encoding, same prohibited paths, same custody entry updated rather than appended twice, same delivery, same removal, same positive absence verification.
SECRET_ROTATION_CONTRACT.what_rotation_does_NOT_do: It does not change any grant, attribute, membership or ownership. A rotation that also altered a privilege would be two acts wearing one name, with one prestate and one rollback between them.
SECRET_ROTATION_CONTRACT.if_rotation_fails_midway: See MUTATION_ROLLBACK_CONTRACT MR-2. The failure mode that matters is a credential SET on the server but NOT successfully delivered: the prior credential is then already dead and the new one is unusable. The compensating action is to re-run the rotation, not to attempt recovery of either value.

that the act REPLACES any existing credential and will break any unrecorded consumer
whether an expiry is being set, and its value (OD-3)
where the credential will be stored and how it will be delivered (OD-2)

The provisioning lane establishes that the capability CAN observe; it does not observe.

Any SELECT from any application or tenant table, including public.users, public.organizations, auth.*, storage.*, and including any COUNT, EXISTS or aggregate over them.
Any pg_proc, pg_class or information_schema ENUMERATION. The authorized catalog reads are keyed lookups over named objects, never scans.
pg_stat_activity, pg_locks or any other session's state.
SET ROLE, RESET ROLE, SET SESSION AUTHORIZATION.
CREATE TEMP TABLE or any other temporary object.

Any CREATE ROLE or DROP ROLE.

TRANSACTION_SHAPE.P1_and_P3: BEGIN READ ONLY; assert transaction_read_only = on; read; ROLLBACK unconditionally, including on the success path. Carried from the parent's reasoning: ROLLBACK unconditionally makes the read-only property structural rather than circumstantial.
TRANSACTION_SHAPE.P2: NOT read-only, necessarily — E-10 measured that GRANT fails inside BEGIN READ ONLY with 25006. Each P2 mutation runs in its OWN transaction, alone, with its prestate already recorded and its rollback already written. One transaction per mutation, never a batch, so that a partial failure has exactly one compensating action.
TRANSACTION_SHAPE.why_P2_is_not_one_big_transaction: Three mutations of three different kinds through two different channels — one of which may not be SQL at all — cannot share a transaction, and pretending they can would produce a rollback story that is false for at least one of them.

PROHIBITED_SQL.note: The operative list is AUTHORIZED_FUTURE_SQL.EXPLICITLY_UNAUTHORIZED_SQL. This section names the four prohibitions that carry their own reasoning because they are the ones a competent lane might argue for.

rows.prohibited: to_regprocedure over either canonical literal, anywhere in the provisioning lane.
rows.the_argument_for_it: It is the cheapest possible proof that the capability now works.
rows.why_it_is_refused: It IS the PRECHECK. Performing it here consumes the observation outside its own authority, outside its own human confirmation, and outside RULE_OBSERVATION_FRESHNESS, which binds an observation to the mutation window it immediately precedes. An observation taken in the provisioning lane is stale before PRECHECK-R2 opens. Mutant M20.
rows.what_is_authorized_instead: has_function_privilege as a boolean, which proves the role's privilege without resolving the literal.

rows.why_it_is_refused: It requires a superuser-class principal, which means smuggling operator access into a capability lane; the hash answers nothing a rotation does not make moot; and the rotation strategy is deliberately designed to be correct WITHOUT the answer.

rows.the_argument_for_it: The auditor already holds EXECUTE on it (stella_hosted_0001:619), it is SECURITY INVOKER and STABLE, it needs no new privilege, and it answers several poststate questions in one statement.
rows.why_it_is_refused: It is outside the exhaustive surface, it answers questions about the INSTALLER's capabilities rather than the auditor's, and its rls_helpers_present and staging_sentinel_present rows are catalog facts about the database that this lane has no business collecting. That it would work and is already granted is precisely the shape of surface creep this artifact exists to refuse. Recorded because a future lane WILL find it and should find this refusal already written.

rows.prohibited: Any REVOKE that narrows the role's pre-existing surface.
rows.the_argument_for_it: The role is over-privileged for this purpose, as this artifact itself states.
rows.why_it_is_refused: Every one of those grants belongs to a governed package with its own contract and its own self-verification — stella_hosted_0006, stella_hosted_0007, stella_0021 and the baseline. Revoking under cover of a capability lane would break their postconditions and would be an authority expansion in the guise of hardening. The over-privilege is RECORDED as OD-4 and left to whoever owns those contracts.

Selecting by name selects the vetoed project. This is not a hypothetical confusion; it is what the two names are.

PHASE_P0_PREREQUISITE.gate: This authority and its companion manifest must be INDEPENDENTLY CERTIFIED, and every owner decision OD-1..OD-6 must be RATIFIED, before P1 opens.

PHASE_P1_HOSTED_CAPABILITY_OBSERVATION.purpose: Determine, by measurement, the hosted answers to HU-1, HU-2, HU-5, HU-6, HU-7, HU-8, HU-9 and HU-10.
PHASE_P1_HOSTED_CAPABILITY_OBSERVATION.precondition: The credential from HC-1 must already exist, because P1 connects AS uellix_auditor. This is the phase-ordering problem stated plainly below.

THE_ORDERING_PROBLEM_AND_ITS_RESOLUTION.the_problem: P1 is supposed to measure the prestate BEFORE any mutation. But the ONLY authorized identity for this lane is uellix_auditor, and connecting as it requires the credential, which is itself the first mutation. Strictly ordered, the prestate cannot be measured before the first mutation.
THE_ORDERING_PROBLEM_AND_ITS_RESOLUTION.the_tempting_resolution_that_is_REFUSED: Connect as an OPERATOR — postgres, supabase_admin or the pooler operator role — to read the prestate first. This would work, would answer every UNKNOWN including HU-3, and is REFUSED. Operator access is a privileged credential; using it would engage SSL-06 at the operator level, would put a lane holding operator power in a position to do far more than it was authorized to, and is precisely the smuggling of operator access into a read-only audit that the lane mandate names and forbids.
THE_ORDERING_PROBLEM_AND_ITS_RESOLUTION.THE_RESOLUTION_ADOPTED: The ORDER IS PRESERVED BY SPLITTING THE PRESTATE, not by escalating. The credential mutation MR-2 has its OWN prestate, which is UNKNOWABLE from the client side by construction (E-9) and is therefore RECORDED AS UNKNOWN rather than measured — an honest UNKNOWN, with the reason, under RULE_FAIL_CLOSED_ON_UNKNOWN. Every OTHER prestate — attributes, memberships, ownership, privileges, PUBLIC-derived privileges — is measured in P1 AFTER the credential exists and BEFORE any of the mutations MR-1 and MR-3 that depend on it. So exactly one mutation proceeds on an UNKNOWN prestate, that fact is declared, and the two mutations that could proceed on a measured prestate do.
THE_ORDERING_PROBLEM_AND_ITS_RESOLUTION.why_this_is_not_mutant_M24: M24 is granting a PRIVILEGE before measuring its prestate. No privilege is granted before P1 measures. The credential is not a privilege; it is an authentication secret whose prior state is provably unobservable from the only identity this lane may hold, and rotation was chosen precisely because it is idempotent over that unknown.
THE_ORDERING_PROBLEM_AND_ITS_RESOLUTION.IF_THE_OWNER_PREFERS_OPERATOR_PRESTATE: It is available as an owner decision and is NOT recommended. Should the owner elect it, it is a DISTINCT privileged act: it engages SSL-06 at the operator level, requires its own human confirmation, requires its own custody entry, and the operator session is read-only and limited to the P1 read list. It is recorded as the alternative under OD-2 rather than smuggled in as a convenience.

MR_1_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE.prestate: rolcanlogin = false for uellix_auditor, read from pg_catalog.pg_roles and RECORDED as a boolean before the mutation.

MR_2_CREDENTIAL.trigger: Always, per SECRET_GENERATION_CONTRACT. It is the act that makes every other measurement possible.
MR_2_CREDENTIAL.prestate: rolpassword existence is UNKNOWN AND IS RECORDED AS UNKNOWN, with the reason: E-9 measured that a client cannot distinguish no-credential from wrong-credential, and reading pg_authid is prohibited by PROHIBITED_SQL. This is the ONE prestate in this contract that is declared rather than measured, and it is declared rather than guessed.
MR_2_CREDENTIAL.mutation: Set a freshly generated credential for uellix_auditor, through the management plane, or through SQL using the set_config bound-parameter pattern so no literal is logged.
MR_2_CREDENTIAL.poststate: A connection opens as uellix_auditor using the new value, and the SERVER reports current_user = session_user = 'uellix_auditor'.
MR_2_CREDENTIAL.verification: The successful authenticated session IS the verification. NO hash is read, and the value is never echoed.
MR_2_CREDENTIAL.rollback: NONE IS POSSIBLE, AND THIS IS DECLARED RATHER THAN DISGUISED. A prior credential cannot be restored because it was never known and its hash is not reversible.
MR_2_CREDENTIAL.COMPENSATING_ACTION: ROTATE AGAIN, or, if the capability is to be withdrawn entirely, ALTER ROLE uellix_auditor PASSWORD NULL, which returns the role to the repository's own designed state of a LOGIN role that cannot authenticate — the state stella_0004:76 describes. That is a real, named, reachable end state and it is what withdrawal means here.
MR_2_CREDENTIAL.reversibility: IRREVERSIBLE AS TO THE PRIOR SECRET. CONVERGENT AS TO THE END STATE.
MR_2_CREDENTIAL.residual_risk_stated: If an unrecorded consumer authenticates as uellix_auditor against staging today, this mutation breaks it without warning. HU-4 means that cannot be excluded. The owner accepts this as part of OD-2.

MR_3_SCHEMA_USAGE_GRANT.trigger: P1 measured KP-3 true (schema exists) AND KP-5 false (USAGE absent).
MR_3_SCHEMA_USAGE_GRANT.prestate: has_schema_privilege('uellix_auditor','uellix_stella_ops','USAGE') = false, RECORDED as a boolean, together with to_regnamespace('uellix_stella_ops') IS NOT NULL = true.
MR_3_SCHEMA_USAGE_GRANT.mutation: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA uellix_stella_ops TO uellix_auditor; — delivered through a governed db/prepared/** package per GRANT_DELIVERY_CHANNEL_ADJUDICATION, not as a loose statement.
MR_3_SCHEMA_USAGE_GRANT.poststate: has_schema_privilege('uellix_auditor','uellix_stella_ops','USAGE') = true, AND has_schema_privilege(...,'CREATE') = false, AND has_function_privilege('uellix_auditor', <each canonical signature>, 'EXECUTE') = false.

MR_3_SCHEMA_USAGE_GRANT.rollback: REVOKE USAGE ON SCHEMA uellix_stella_ops FROM uellix_auditor; — EXACT, restoring the recorded false.
MR_3_SCHEMA_USAGE_GRANT.rollback_precondition: The rollback is issued ONLY if the recorded prestate was false. If the prestate was true, no mutation occurred and there is nothing to reverse; revoking then would remove a privilege this act did not create.

A closed-world census IS possible and is NOT authorized here, because it is a catalog enumeration the parent's EXPLICITLY_UNAUTHORIZED_READS refuses and because SSL-01 makes a closed-world census a gate of its own rather than a step in a capability lane.
The proof is a POINT-IN-TIME observation. It says nothing about the state five minutes later, and RULE_OBSERVATION_FRESHNESS is what binds it to the window it precedes.
MG-5 is carried: no control this artifact authorizes can exclude a hosted mutation made outside the governed chain tooling. The attempt ledgers record only attempts opened through that tooling.
The proof covers uellix_auditor. It says nothing about what any OTHER principal can do to the same database, and must not be cited as though it did.
PostgreSQL grants an object's owner privileges that no ACL row shows. PV-15..PV-19 assert the auditor owns nothing, which closes this for the auditor and for nobody else.

decisions.question: PERSISTENT OR EPHEMERAL AUDITOR CREDENTIAL, and is rotation after the FINAL WITNESS MANDATORY?
decisions.repository_position: UNDETERMINED. db/safety/resolve-capability-database-url.ts describes uellix_auditor as a standing capability with its own variable and its own lifetime, which points at persistence; the parent's SECRET_CUSTODY_CONTRACT points at minimal exposure, which points at ephemeral. Neither decides.
options: persistent role with a rotated execution secret
decisions.engineering_recommendation: Persistent role with a rotated execution secret, rotated after the FINAL WITNESS. The third option is argued against in SECRET_GENERATION_CONTRACT and is not recommended in any form.
decisions.consequence_if_unratified: MR-2 cannot fire, so P1 cannot run.

decisions.question: APPROVED SECRET CUSTODY AND DELIVERY MECHANISM, the SSL-06 inventory surface, acceptance of the rotation break-risk, and whether an operator-credential prestate read is elected.
decisions.repository_position: UNDETERMINED AND EXPLICITLY DEFERRED. The parent states in terms that it does not name, choose, create, rotate or compare an approved secure source. No secret store, credential vault or custody inventory exists at AS_OF_TREE, and MRS_4 establishes that the one path the CODE names, .env.audit.local, is forbidden by the parent for the hosted case.
sub_decisions: Which custody mechanism holds the value.
Which delivery mechanism places it in the process environment, and whether a Windows user-scope environment variable is accepted under the five binding conditions in SECRET_DELIVERY_CONTRACT.
Where the SSL-06 custody inventory lives, given that no such surface exists.
Acceptance that rotation may break an unrecorded consumer (HU-4).
Whether the operator-credential prestate read is elected, which would engage SSL-06 at the operator level and require its own confirmation and custody entry.
decisions.engineering_recommendation: A secret manager or OS credential vault read into the process environment at invocation; the custody inventory as a NAMES-ONLY tracked document under docs/ops/staging/; and the operator prestate read NOT elected.
decisions.consequence_if_unratified: MR-2 cannot fire and P4 has no compliant mechanism, so STOP_SECRET_DELIVERY_NONCOMPLIANT.

decisions.question: CREDENTIAL EXPIRATION POLICY — is VALID UNTIL set, and to what?
decisions.repository_position: UNDETERMINED. No package sets rolvaliduntil on any role.
decisions.engineering_recommendation: Set it, to a date shortly after the planned FINAL WITNESS, and RECORD the exact UTC timestamp in the capability evidence. An unrecorded expiry converts a scheduled event into an unexplained outage that E-9 shows presents as an ordinary authentication failure.

decisions.question: SHOULD A NARROWER CAPABILITY EXIST FOR CATALOG OBSERVATION, given that uellix_auditor reads roughly forty tables of customer data to answer a question about six function signatures?
decisions.repository_position: DETERMINED AGAINST CHANGING IT, FOR NOW. The parent names uellix_auditor as its AUTHORIZED_DATABASE_ROLE as a frozen constant and db/safety/database-role.ts pins it as a compile-time constant. This artifact therefore does NOT propose a different role.
decisions.why_it_is_raised_anyway: Because the mismatch between what the capability CAN read and what the observation NEEDS is the single largest security fact this adjudication uncovered, and burying it inside a contract that works around it would be the comfortable thing to do.
decisions.engineering_recommendation: Raise it as a SUCCESSOR question after D1-8 closes. Do NOT let it block D-1: a narrower role is a new identity, a new credential, a new grant chain and a new certification, and the marginal risk of one governed read-only session with the existing role is smaller than the risk of that whole chain being built in a hurry.
decisions.consequence_if_unratified: NONE for P1..P5. Recorded so it is not lost.

decisions.question: MAY THE MR-3 GRANT BE DELIVERED AS AN AD-HOC GOVERNED STATEMENT INSTEAD OF A db/prepared/** PACKAGE?
decisions.repository_position: PRECEDENT FAVOURS THE PACKAGE. Every hosted GRANT in this repository's history travels through a prepared package. GRANT_DELIVERY_CHANNEL_ADJUDICATION rules for the package.
decisions.why_the_owner_is_asked_anyway: Because the package route requires a protected-surface allocation that does not exist, which is a real gate with real latency, and the owner may judge that a single reversible GRANT with a recorded prestate and an exact REVOKE does not warrant it. That judgement is the owner's to make deliberately; what this artifact refuses is a successor making it quietly because the gate was inconvenient.
decisions.engineering_recommendation: Keep the package route. The precedent is worth more to a future mistake than this grant is worth to this lane.
decisions.consequence_if_unratified: MR-3 is blocked behind STOP_PROTECTED_SURFACE_ALLOCATION_ABSENT, should it be triggered at all.

decisions.question: SHOULD INDEPENDENT-CERTIFICATION VERDICTS BE MATERIALIZED AS TRACKED REPOSITORY EVIDENCE?
decisions.repository_position: UNDETERMINED. CERTIFICATION_PREREQUISITE_OF_THE_PARENT records that PR #202's CERTIFIED_PASS is an owner affirmation with no tracked artifact at AS_OF_TREE, while the merge itself is in git.
decisions.why_it_belongs_here: This artifact will itself require independent certification, and it will face the identical gap. A chain in which merges are auditable and verdicts are not is a chain a third party cannot walk.
decisions.engineering_recommendation: Materialize certification verdicts as tracked artifacts going forward. NOT retroactively: reconstructing a past verdict as a document would be writing history rather than recording it.

required_independent_review.reason: This artifact authorizes a hosted credential mutation and a hosted privilege grant that two frozen authorities withheld, and it adjudicates a security stop line in a direction the immediate parent did not. An authority written by the lane that derived its own minimum, certified by nobody, would be the programme trusting a single reading of its own evidence on exactly the surface where a single reading is least safe.
adversarial_questions_the_certifier_shou: Is the DELTA framing of MINIMUM_PRIVILEGE_CONTRACT a genuine adjudication, or is it an escape from the uncomfortable total that uellix_auditor reads roughly forty tables to answer a six-signature question? Press OF-7 and OD-4.

Is SSL_06_ADJUDICATION a legitimate scope distinction, or is it this artifact overruling a certified parent on a security stop line? Press OF-6, and test whether the parent's clause really is scoped to its own grant.

Does E-2 actually prove EXECUTE is unnecessary, or did the substrate leave some other privilege in place that carried the resolution? Re-run it: the claim is that has_function_privilege was false and resolution still succeeded byte-identically.

Does E-4 survive scrutiny? Revoking SELECT on pg_catalog.pg_proc from PUBLIC is an unusual act; verify the revoke actually took effect (a direct read raised permission denied) before accepting that resolution bypassed the ACL.
Is OF-8 mutant M24 in disguise? One mutation proceeds on an unknown prestate. Test whether the operator-credential alternative was refused on principle or on convenience.
Is the OF-5 lineage divergence really two lineages, or is it one contradiction that should STOP? Press whether stella_0004 could ever run against the hosted target.
Is the ROLE_MEMBERSHIP_CONTRACT's zero-membership assertion actually sufficient, given that it is a point-in-time check and INHERIT is set on the hosted lineage?

Does GRANT_DELIVERY_CHANNEL_ADJUDICATION create a gate that will never be satisfied, effectively blocking D1-8 forever behind a protected-surface allocation? If so, is OD-5 the right escape valve or a loophole?
Is PV-32 — asserting that the auditor can still read public.users — defensible as a sentinel, or is it an assertion that entrenches over-privilege?
Are the FAIL_CLOSED_TOKENS actually total over the outcomes, or is there a reachable state with no token?
required_independent_review.what_a_certifier_may_NOT_do: It may not certify by re-deriving the same conclusions from the same reading. The measurements are re-runnable by construction and the certifier should re-run the ones that carry weight.
